title: Fruit Puffs
description: Light, golden muffins made with blackberries, ripe bananas and eggs. No flour, no sugar — the fruit juices burst throughout the sponge as they bake.
steps: Preheat the oven to 210°C/190°C fan. Line a muffin tray with 10 paper cases. Place 3–4 blackberries in the bottom of each case.
Mash the bananas together. In a separate bowl whisk the eggs, then add the mashed bananas. Beat with an electric whisk for several minutes until light and fluffy.
Divide the mixture between the muffin cases, filling each almost to the top.
Bake for 15–20 minutes, or until risen and golden.
Allow to cool fully in the tin before eating.
notes: Makes 10 puffs. Eat within 2 days as the fruit makes them very moist. Try raspberries or blueberries.
